findings: Capture requires exact sealed terminal journal, execution, source and pin identities, terminal cleanup and original14 input-pin continuity.
Both original replay directories retain XML and all compact native search history regardless of outcome. Failed objective/native profiles and missing-execution closure failures are distinguished.
Collector completion follows actual returncode/result artifact rather than an invented per-step status. Failed or partially written collector output is inventoried without promoting completeness.
Source bytes, compressed bytes, expanded bytes and source-relative mapping are validated before fresh local output creation;16MiB stored/64MiB expanded and aggregate stored bounds are preserved.
Native binaries, source trees and raw row spools remain outside transfer; failed retained factors receive explicit external hashes.
Terminal plan remains unsealed until actual closed journal hashes exist. No native gate or classification code changed.
limitations: Fabricated test and source review only; no09 capture, remote transfer or scientific verdict was performed.
The subsequent independent terminal audit separately verifies live source/input/binary bytes, numerical arithmetic and exact process absence.
resolved_finding: Incomplete objective points can fail in physical closure before profile.execution.json. The final selector explicitly retains their root compact evidence and closure propagation JSON/log/XML/derivatives, with a missing-execution label; bulky orbit/variational data stay external.
